mapper.sql: SELECT t.*, t.student_name AS student_name, o.name AS organization_name FROM course_template t LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = t.organization_id

WHERE t.user_id = #{userId}
AND t.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
mapper.select: ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM course_template WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_template(user_id, title, student_id, student_name, organization_id, subject, stage, course_type, duration_minutes, fee, fee_manual, location, note, color, repeat_type) VALUES(#{userId}, #{title}, #{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{organizationId}, #{subject}, #{stage}, #{courseType}, #{durationMinutes}, #{fee}, #{feeManual}, #{location}, #{note}, #{color}, #{repeatType})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM course_template WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
